# Southern Living

> Southern Living is a lifestyle publication covering food, home, garden, travel, holidays, style, and Southern culture.

Southern Living publishes recipes, decorating ideas, gardening advice, travel inspiration, entertaining guides, and seasonal content focused on life in the American South.

## Food & Recipes
- [Recipes](https://www.southernliving.com/recipes): Recipe hub for Southern classics, weeknight dinners, desserts, and seasonal dishes.
- [Dinner](https://www.southernliving.com/food/dinner): Dinner ideas including casseroles, comfort food, and easy family meals.
- [Desserts](https://www.southernliving.com/food/desserts): Cakes, pies, cookies, cobblers, and other Southern dessert recipes.
- [Appetizers](https://www.southernliving.com/food/appetizers): Party starters, dips, finger foods, and entertaining recipes.
- [Breakfast](https://www.southernliving.com/food/breakfast): Breakfast and brunch recipes from biscuits to casseroles.
- [Drinks](https://www.southernliving.com/food/drinks): Cocktails, punches, teas, and other beverage recipes.
- [Kitchen Assistant](https://www.southernliving.com/food/kitchen-assistant): Cooking tips, ingredient guidance, and kitchen how-to content.

## Home & Decorating
- [Home](https://www.southernliving.com/home): Home hub for decorating, organizing, cleaning, and design inspiration.
- [Decorating Ideas](https://www.southernliving.com/home/decor): Room-by-room decorating advice and style inspiration.
- [Living Room](https://www.southernliving.com/home/decor/living-room): Living room decorating ideas, layouts, and design tips.
- [Kitchen Design](https://www.southernliving.com/home/kitchen): Kitchen decorating, layout, and renovation inspiration.
- [Bathroom Design](https://www.southernliving.com/home/bathroom): Bathroom ideas covering style, storage, and remodeling.
- [Cleaning and Housekeeping](https://www.southernliving.com/home/cleaning-and-housekeeping): Cleaning routines, stain removal, and household maintenance advice.
- [Organization](https://www.southernliving.com/home/organization): Storage and organization ideas for closets, kitchens, and whole-home order.

## Garden & Outdoor Living
- [Garden](https://www.southernliving.com/garden): Gardening hub with plant guides, landscaping ideas, and yard care advice.
- [Flowers](https://www.southernliving.com/garden/flowers): Flower-growing advice, seasonal blooms, and planting inspiration.
- [Shrubs](https://www.southernliving.com/garden/shrubs): Shrub selection, care tips, and landscape planning guidance.
- [Trees](https://www.southernliving.com/garden/trees): Tree recommendations, care information, and Southern landscape ideas.
- [Container Gardens](https://www.southernliving.com/garden/container-gardens): Container planting ideas for porches, patios, and small spaces.
- [Landscaping Ideas](https://www.southernliving.com/garden/landscaping-ideas): Outdoor design inspiration for gardens, paths, and curb appeal.
- [Outdoor Living](https://www.southernliving.com/garden/outdoor-living): Patios, porches, entertaining spaces, and backyard ideas.

## Travel
- [Travel](https://www.southernliving.com/travel): Travel hub featuring Southern destinations, itineraries, and local recommendations.
- [South's Best](https://www.southernliving.com/travel/souths-best): Annual rankings and editorial picks for top Southern places and experiences.
- [Beaches](https://www.southernliving.com/travel/beaches): Beach destination guides across the South.
- [Small Towns](https://www.southernliving.com/travel/small-towns): Guides to charming Southern small towns and weekend escapes.
- [Hotels](https://www.southernliving.com/travel/hotels): Hotel recommendations, resort roundups, and stay inspiration.
- [Weekend Getaways](https://www.southernliving.com/travel/weekend-getaways): Short-trip ideas and itineraries for Southern travelers.
- [National Parks](https://www.southernliving.com/travel/national-parks): National park travel inspiration with Southern relevance.

## Holidays & Entertaining
- [Holidays](https://www.southernliving.com/holidays-occasions): Holiday hub for seasonal recipes, decor, and traditions.
- [Christmas](https://www.southernliving.com/christmas): Christmas recipes, decorating ideas, gift guides, and traditions.
- [Thanksgiving](https://www.southernliving.com/thanksgiving): Thanksgiving menus, side dishes, hosting tips, and table ideas.
- [Easter](https://www.southernliving.com/easter): Easter meal ideas, brunch recipes, and spring decorating inspiration.
- [Halloween](https://www.southernliving.com/halloween): Halloween food, decor, costumes, and party ideas.
- [Mardi Gras](https://www.southernliving.com/holidays-occasions/mardi-gras): Mardi Gras recipes, traditions, and celebration ideas.
- [Entertaining](https://www.southernliving.com/culture/entertaining): Hosting advice, party menus, and gathering inspiration.

## Style & Beauty
- [Style & Beauty](https://www.southernliving.com/fashion-beauty): Style and beauty coverage including hair, fashion, and skincare.
- [Fashion](https://www.southernliving.com/fashion-beauty/fashion): Clothing trends, outfit ideas, and seasonal style advice.
- [Beauty](https://www.southernliving.com/fashion-beauty/beauty): Beauty recommendations, skincare tips, and product guidance.
- [Hair](https://www.southernliving.com/fashion-beauty/hairstyles): Hairstyle ideas, cuts, color inspiration, and maintenance tips.
- [Makeup](https://www.southernliving.com/fashion-beauty/makeup): Makeup tutorials, product picks, and beauty how-to content.
- [Nails](https://www.southernliving.com/fashion-beauty/nails): Nail color ideas, manicure trends, and seasonal inspiration.

## Culture & Southern Life
- [Culture](https://www.southernliving.com/culture): Stories about Southern traditions, people, etiquette, and everyday life.
- [Southern Living News](https://www.southernliving.com/news): News and trending stories from across Southern Living topics.
- [Things Southerners Know](https://www.southernliving.com/culture/things-southerners-know): Essays and features about shared Southern customs and perspectives.
- [Traditions](https://www.southernliving.com/culture/traditions): Coverage of regional customs, celebrations, and heritage.
- [Etiquette](https://www.southernliving.com/culture/etiquette): Advice on manners, hosting, and social norms in Southern life.
- [Books](https://www.southernliving.com/culture/books): Reading recommendations and literary coverage with Southern interest.
- [Pets](https://www.southernliving.com/culture/pets): Pet stories, advice, and lifestyle features.

## House Plans
- [Southern Living House Plans](https://houseplans.southernliving.com/): Official house plan marketplace for Southern-inspired residential designs.
- [Search House Plans](https://houseplans.southernliving.com/search): Searchable catalog of home plans by size, style, and features.
- [About House Plans](https://houseplans.southernliving.com/about-us): Overview of the house plans program and brand background.
- [Custom Builder Program](https://houseplans.southernliving.com/custom-builder-program): Information for builders participating in the Southern Living program.
- [Idea House](https://houseplans.southernliving.com/idea-house): Showcase of featured homes and design inspiration from the Idea House program.
- [Inspired Communities](https://houseplans.southernliving.com/inspired-communities): Communities featuring homes built from Southern Living plans.
